reader_note: The value is the composition core of Macy's 2023 proxy: the 12-of-14 independence count, Bryant and Hale leaving with the cut from 16 to 14 seats, every nominee card's independence and committee fields, the four committee pages with their independence statements, the Board's independence determination and Varga's lead-director election; 1107 (the basis of the independence review) and 1150 (a lead-director selection criterion) state no composition fact, and the committee pages carry no chair marks in their text, so chairs come only from the cards, 620 and the report signatures. The pool holds Granoff's own 'Independent' field (945, the one card field left out), Tony Spring's appointment to the Board in the CEO letter (40, stated nowhere else), the leadership-structure paragraphs 1110-1112, the Audit and CMD report signatures and repeated 'election of 14 directors' lines. I left out the Digital Innovation Task Force (1352: three directors plus management, not a board committee), table legends, role labels in compensation/ESG/ownership tables and the stock table's '14 individuals' row.
